review.failed: The review queue could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
review.pick: Choose a pair from the queue. J and K move through it.
review.unknown: This pair is not in the queue any more. Choose another one.

queue.title: Review queue
queue.conflictsOnly: Only pairs with a conflicting field
queue.emptyOpen: Nothing left to decide with these filters.

evidence.question: Do these two records describe the same organisation?
evidence.scaleLabel: Calibrated probability {{p}}. The machine rejects below {{lo}} and accepts from {{hi}}.
evidence.bands: The machine rejects below {{lo}} and accepts from {{hi}}
evidence.whyUnsure: Why the machine could not decide
evidence.vetoed: A hard rule also blocks an automatic merge of these two records.
evidence.sum: The matcher starts at {{prior}}, because two records picked at random rarely match. The fields add {{fields}}, which gives {{total}}. The probability above is that total after calibration.

explain.sameButCommon: Both records say “{{left}}”, yet the matcher counts this against a match.
explain.close: “{{left}}” and “{{right}}” are close enough to count for a match.
explain.missingBoth: Neither record has a value, so this says nothing.
explain.missingLeft: Record A has no value, so this says nothing.
explain.missingRight: Record B has no value, so this says nothing.

cluster.title_one: The group around this pair: {{count}} record
cluster.title_other: The group around this pair: {{count}} records
cluster.bridge: This pair is the only link between two parts of the group: {{a}} records on one side, {{b}} on the other. Calling it different splits the group there.
cluster.drawing: {{count}} records and {{links}} links between them; the list beside the drawing names the records.

reason.related: Related, but not the same (parent, subsidiary, division)
reason.group_split: Split off by a decision about the whole group

sheet.replaces: This replaces the decision in force. The earlier one stays in the history:

notice.failed: The decision could not be recorded. Try again.

qa.bandValue: {{pairs}} pairs in {{groups}} groups; the {{loaded}} groups that settle most are loaded

audit.title_one: A sample of {{count}} pair the machine accepted on its own
audit.title_other: A sample of {{count}} pairs the machine accepted on its own
audit.help: Drawn at random from everything above the accept band. Read-only in this prototype.
audit.simulated: {{right}} of {{total}} are the same organisation in the generator's truth. A real estate has no such column; there a reviewer's audit takes its place.

graph.headline: {{records}} records from {{systems}} source systems describe {{organisations}} organisations

tile.multi: Backed by more than one record

graph.schemaTitle: What is in the graph, and how it connects
graph.schemaDeclared: The schema is declared for this synthetic estate: it follows the source columns. Proposing a schema from the data is designed, not built.
graph.schemaInduced: The schema was proposed from the data and approved.
graph.attributes: How often each attribute has a value
graph.sampleNote: {{shown}} shown. This preview carries {{sample}} of the {{total}} organisations in full.
graph.searchLabel: Name of an organisation, city or industry
graph.noHits: Nothing in this preview has that in its name.
graph.unknown: This preview does not carry that node.
graph.orgSummary_one: Backed by {{n}} record from {{systems}} source system
graph.orgSummary_other: Backed by {{n}} records from {{systems}} source systems
graph.refSummary: {{n}} organisations in the estate; {{listed}} of them are carried in this preview
graph.systemSummary: {{n}} records in the estate; {{listed}} organisations with a record here are carried in this preview
graph.valuesHelp: Each value with the number of records that give it. More than one value in a row means the records disagree.
graph.openHelp: The review band has not decided these. Until someone does, they stay separate organisations.

group.title: The whole group
group.help_one: One decision for the {{count}} record of this group. It decides the pairs that are still open; a pair you already decided stays as it is.
group.help_other: One decision for all {{count}} records of this group. It decides the pairs that are still open; a pair you already decided stays as it is.
group.mergeTitle_one: Decide this {{count}} record as one organisation
group.mergeTitle_other: Decide all {{count}} records as one organisation
group.nothingOpen: No pair in this group is open, so there is nothing to decide.
group.kept_one: {{count}} pair already has a decision and stays as it is.
group.kept_other: {{count}} pairs already have a decision and stay as they are.
group.disagree_one: {{count}} of those decisions says otherwise. If it is wrong, change it on the pair itself.
group.disagree_other: {{count}} of those decisions say otherwise. If they are wrong, change them on the pairs themselves.
group.separates_one: This split separates {{count}} pair the machine accepted on its own. That pair is not in the review queue, so it is recorded with the split as an objection and not decided here.
group.separates_other: This split separates {{count}} pairs the machine accepted on its own. Those pairs are not in the review queue, so they are recorded with the split as objections and not decided here.
group.splitHelp: Give each record a letter. Records with the same letter are one organisation. The starting point follows the links the machine accepted and the pairs you called the same.
group.splitOutcome: {{parts}} organisations. Open pairs that become Same: {{same}}. Open pairs that become Different: {{different}}.
group.onePart: Every record has the same letter. Give at least one record another letter, or use “All one organisation”.

recorded.merge_one: Group decided as one organisation: {{count}} pair recorded
recorded.merge_other: Group decided as one organisation: {{count}} pairs recorded

group.recordedSeparates_one: It separates {{count}} pair the machine had accepted; recorded as an objection.
group.recordedSeparates_other: It separates {{count}} pairs the machine had accepted; recorded as objections.
group.undone: Undone, or decided again since: no pair still rests on this group decision.

suggest.title: Suggestion

record.same: Among pairs already decided that look like this one, {{agree}} of {{total}} were the same. What they have in common:
record.different: Among pairs already decided that look like this one, {{agree}} of {{total}} were different. What they have in common:

suggest.trust: Checked on {{pairs}} decided pairs the suggestion had not seen: right in {{right}} of 100.
suggest.baseline: Calling every pair the same would be right in {{right}} of 100.
suggest.synthetic: On this synthetic data the generator's truth stands in for recorded decisions.
